home.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: redesigned Japanese app development STUDIO HOMEPAGE, desktop 1440px wide by approx 2200px tall.
Primary request: The user corrected the brief: homepage must feel like an APP DEVELOPMENT STUDIO PORTFOLIO showing Works, not a diagnosis sales landing page. AI App Clinic is the most prominent featured work/service within Works, other apps also visible. The two attached screenshots are style and product references, not edit targets. Preserve existing There There Studio identity, warm cream #f7f0d4, raspberry #bd4562, mustard #ebb956, near-black 2px borders and small hard shadows, Japanese Noto Sans typography, bold English grotesque.
Header: existing tt. square logo + "There There Studio", navigation "Works" "スタジオについて" "ブログ" and raspberry "お問い合わせ".
Hero: generous two columns; left large English wordmark "There There" / raspberry "Studio.", Japanese headline "小さなアイデアを、" newline "使えるかたちに。", copy "WebとiOSのアプリ開発から、" newline "AIでつくったアプリの診断・運用相談まで。", primary raspberry button "つくっているものを見る", quiet underlined link "AIアプリ診療所について". Right arrange the existing screenshot images of recorder and checklist apps as two elegant slightly tilted full rectangular panels, showing actual products, no invented illustration; subtle flat mustard backdrop consistent with existing screenshot. Restrained and deliberate. Thin band "WEB APPS / iOS APPS / APP SUPPORT".
Next Works section: oversized "Works." and small descriptor "つくっているもの、支えていること。". FIRST featured work full-width bordered mustard/cream two-column panel. Left small "FEATURED / 診断・運用支援", large "AIアプリ診療所", headline "「動いた」の、その先を一緒に。", short explanation of diagnosis, priorities and self-directed fixes, visible "診断・アドバイス 33,000円（税込）", button "診断について詳しく見る". Right a white readable diagnostic report sample with title "診断レポート", SAMPLE label, three issue rows: "権限とデータ" "公開設定" "復旧の備え". This panel makes AI diagnosis commercially prominent without hijacking the studio positioning.
Below the featured panel: three equal compact product tiles with existing images showing "怪獣スタンプ" (pink wallet app), "レコーダー維新" (blue recorder art), "チェックリスト維新" (blue checklist art). Brief one-line captions. These are existing published apps, no fictional customer names.
Bottom begins editorial Studio intro "自分でつくる。だから、寄り添える。" with compact experience summary no fake person photo.
Constraints: studio homepage first, Works centered, preserve actual brand/product references, no fake metrics/testimonials, no enormous diagnosis hero, no gradients, no browser chrome. Generous whitespace, strong typography. Date anchor 2026-11-07, no dates needed.

clinic.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: desktop Japanese AI app diagnosis service detail page, recommended final UI to implement; 1440px wide scrollable view approx 2100px tall.
Primary request: Create the matching /app-clinic detail page for an existing Japanese studio site. Attached current screenshot is design grounding. Preserve existing cream paper #f7f0d4, raspberry #bd4562 primary buttons, mustard #ebb956 accents, near-black ink, thin black edges, restrained hard shadows. Highly readable Noto Sans JP typography. No announcement banner. Flat website screenshot no browser chrome.
Header logo "AIアプリ診療所" small "BY THERE THERE STUDIO"; navigation "診断内容" "レポート例" "料金" and main button "診断を相談する". Small breadcrumb "ホーム / AIアプリ診断".
Hero left eyebrow "AIでつくったWebアプリの診断"; headline "何を直すか。" newline "どう直すか。" newline "一緒に、明確に。"; short support about permissions, data, deployment, and your own ability to improve. CTA "診断について相談する"; modest price "33,000円（税込）". Right white bordered diagnosis report SAMPLE with mustard title bar "診断レポート / サンプル", title "予約アプリの公開前チェック", three report lines numbered 01 "権限・データ" with status "優先して対応", 02 "公開設定" with "改善を推奨", 03 "復旧の備え" with "要確認". Bottom text "根拠・優先順位・直し方・確認方法".
Below a full width muted cream section: eyebrow "01 / 診断で確認すること"; large "公開の前も、その後も。" Three open columns with fine vertical separators for "権限とデータ" / "秘密情報と公開設定" / "異変への備え". Next section eyebrow "02 / レポートの例"; heading "指摘だけで、終わらせません。" A spacious report excerpt grid: left 1/3 explanatory heading "自分で直すための、道しるべ。" and explanatory paragraph, right 2/3 actual readable report excerpt, SAMPLE prominently; issue title "他の利用者の予約が見える可能性"; highlighted "優先度 高"; editorial rows "確認したこと", "影響", "改善の手順", "修正後の確認", "未確認のこと". Bottom begins pricing section with one simple white black-outlined panel containing "診断・アドバイス", large "33,000円" "(税込)" and 3 inclusions "診断レポート / 改善の手順 / 結果の説明", same primary CTA.
Constraints: one coherent page, no collage, no fictional testimonials, no performance metrics, no invented guarantee or turnaround time. Diagnosis by experienced human with AI-made apps as subject. No decorative illustration. Generous whitespace. Match existing style while strengthening clear hierarchy and concrete deliverables. Date anchor 2026-11-07 but omit dates.

notes: Top page follows user's revised studio/Works direction.
Concept raster images are references, not UI screenshots or production text.
Existing operator and product images are used in the implementation.
